nodes.description: Public string state variable 'name' storing the token name, set in the constructor.
Public string state variable 'symbol' storing the token symbol, set in the constructor.
Public uint8 state variable 'decimals', set to 18 in the constructor.
Public uint256 state variable '_totalSupply' holding the total token supply, written in the constructor and read in totalSupply().
Mapping(address => uint) 'balances' tracking token balances; written in the constructor, transfer and transferFrom, read in balanceOf and totalSupply.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) 'allowed' storing ERC20 allowances; written in approve and transferFrom, read in allowance.
Constructor of KomandoInu that initializes name, symbol, decimals, _totalSupply and mints the whole supply to msg.sender.
External view totalSupply() returning _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using an unchecked subtraction.
Public view balanceOf(address tokenOwner) returning balances[tokenOwner].
Public view allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approve(address spender, uint tokens) writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval.
transfer(address to, uint tokens) moves balances using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens) decrements balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender] and increments balances[to], emitting Transfer.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b) performing checked addition with overflow require.
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b) performing checked subtraction requiring b <= a.
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b) performing checked multiplication with overflow require.
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b) performing division with require(b > 0).
msg.sender used as the minter in the constructor and as the account/allowance owner in approve, transfer and transferFrom.
Unchecked arithmetic subtraction '_totalSupply - balances[address(0)]' in totalSupply() with no SafeMath protection.
Integer addition 'c = a + b' inside safeAdd guarded by require(c >= a).
Integer subtraction 'c = a - b' inside safeSub guarded by require(b <= a).
Integer multiplication 'c = a * b' inside safeMul guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Integer division 'c = a / b' inside safeDiv guarded by require(b > 0).
Parameter tokenOwner of balanceOf used as the lookup key into balances.
Parameter tokenOwner of allowance used as the first key into allowed.
Parameter spender of allowance used as the second key into allowed.
Parameter spender of approve used as the second key into allowed.
Parameter tokens of approve used as the allowance amount written to allowed.
Parameter to of transfer, the recipient of the transferred tokens.
Parameter tokens of transfer, the amount moved from the caller to 'to'.
Parameter from of transferFrom, the account whose balance and allowance are debited.
Parameter to of transferFrom, the recipient of the transferred tokens.
Parameter tokens of transferFrom, the amount transferred.
First operand 'a' of safeAdd.
Second operand 'b' of safeAdd.
Return local 'c' of safeAdd holding a + b.
First operand 'a' of safeSub.
Second operand 'b' of safeSub.
Return local 'c' of safeSub holding a - b.
First operand 'a' of safeMul.
Second operand 'b' of safeMul.
Return local 'c' of safeMul holding a * b.
Numerator 'a' of safeDiv.
Denominator 'b' of safeDiv.
Return local 'c' of safeDiv holding a / b.
